description: A painting of an open beige desktop PC case seen from above and to the side. A green circuit-board graphics card with a black fan and metal heatsink sits seated in a slot, with RAM sticks, a power supply, and ribbon and power cables around it. Two beige CRT monitors on the desk show low-poly green and blue landscapes, and a desk lamp glows at the top. The scene is dim and warm, with no people and no legible text.
